Synthetic source triangle and cutter in millimeters, with interior endpoints (0.2, 0.2, 0) and (0.4, 0.4, 0). QuickSurface Pro 8.0.123 Split Mesh, Envelope disabled, produced five source faces. Edit Scan reported one individual mesh and one hole both before and after the split. The saved session and source-only STL are included. The test uses fixed offsets for this hashed session only, not a general QSF specification; the two incident faces share the indexed cut edge. The expected-failure test documents an outstanding ScanForge/native facet difference.
